title: ProBuild Rewards Earning Rate Card
content:
Perks points under Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards are earned per pre-tax qualifying dollar at the rate of the member's tier. The rate card below sets, tier by tier, the earning rate, the extra multiplier for purchases paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account, the waiting period before purchase points can be redeemed, the yearly ceiling on points earned, and which kinds of purchase earn points.

## Earning rates

| Tier | Points per pre-tax qualifying dollar | Extra multiplier on purchases paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account | Days after the purchase before earned points can be redeemed | Most points earned in one program year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 1.00 | 1.00 | 30 | 100000 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 1.10 | 1.00 | 30 | 150000 |
| ProBuild Silver | 1.25 | 1.00 | 30 | 250000 |
| ProBuild Gold | 1.50 | 1.25 | 14 | 500000 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 1.75 | 1.25 | 14 | 1000000 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 2.00 | 1.50 | 7 | 2000000 |

An extra multiplier of 1.00 leaves the points on a purchase unchanged, so at ProBuild Member, ProBuild Bronze and ProBuild Silver a purchase paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account earns the same points as one paid any other way.

## Which purchases earn points

| Tier | Tool rental charges | Installation contract payments | Special order purchases | Purchases priced under a volume pricing quote | Gift card purchases excluded from qualifying spend and points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| ProBuild Bronze | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| ProBuild Silver | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Gold | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

"Yes" in the first four columns means that kind of purchase earns points at that tier; "No" means it does not. "Yes" in the last column means gift card purchases are excluded from both qualifying spend and points, which is the case at every tier.

## Reading the card (hypothetical cases)

- A tool rental charge earns no points at ProBuild Bronze and earns points at ProBuild Silver.
- Installation contract payments earn points only at ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite.
- Points on a purchase at ProBuild Gold can be redeemed 14 days after the purchase; at ProBuild Member, 30 days after.
